jobs.name: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain enterprise applications using .NET 5 or above, C#, and Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Develop, integrate, and maintain RESTful APIs and ensure proper API documentation, integration standards, and system reliability.
  • Design and implement efficient database structures, SQL queries, and database operations using DML, DDL, and other SQL programming techniques.
  • Develop and maintain responsive application interfaces using JavaScript, jQuery, and UI frameworks such as Telerik Kendo UI.
  • Prepare and maintain technical documentation, system architecture diagrams, and application design specifications.
  • Perform system integration testing (SIT), support user acceptance testing (UAT), and collaborate with relevant stakeholders to ensure application quality.
  • Support security testing activities, including penetration testing, vulnerability remediation, and implementation of recommended security improvements.
  • Troubleshoot application issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement effective solutions to improve system performance and stability.
  • Manage source code and collaborate with development teams using Git and established version control practices.
  • Contribute to application deployment, environment configuration, and containerized application management where applicable.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, QA engineers, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders, to deliver effective software solutions.
jobs.qualifications:
Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field from a reputable university.
  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in software development, with strong hands-on experience in .NET 5 or above, C#, and Microsoft SQL Server.
